# Implement UI Feature

Use this sequence:

1. State the user outcome and acceptance criteria.
2. Audit repository, current UI and design-system context.
3. Identify assumptions and missing information.
4. Define the flow and important UI states.
5. Map the design to existing components and tokens.
6. Implement the smallest coherent change.
7. Verify behaviour, accessibility, responsiveness and rendered output where tooling allows.
8. Report evidence, remaining risks and follow-up work.

Do not invent product behaviour silently. Escalate ambiguity that materially changes the experience.
